title: Lemon-Glazed Greek Ricotta Galette
description: A comforting pastry made with sesame butter, ricotta cheese, and a tangy lemon glaze, reminiscent of traditional Greek galaktoboureko, served in a beautiful slate-tile vessel.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the ricotta cheese, sesame butter, granulated sugar, and eggs until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the dough to a 9x13 inch (23x33 cm) slate-tile vessel and trim the edges to fit.
Spread the ferment-kimchi over the dough, leaving a 1 inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a crust, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
While the galette is baking, prepare the lemon glaze by whisking together the lemon juice and honey in a small bowl.
Once the galette is done, remove it from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the lemon glaze over the galette and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg.
